title: Light Crucified and the Two Essences
description: T54 describes the appointed moment when the divine humanity goes forth into the soul's contest, presses in upon the disordered natural, and the operative power rises from the depths — leaving the proprium's storehouses inactive. The forms that had been pursuing the elements find that what they were drawing upon has been gathered up; what is left is only what could not be raised. The body without soul is dead because the one working every operation has gone forth. T55 expounds the building of the dwelling: when the natural mind is ready, the operative power and the life-bearing principle take up the firstfruits of the rational's five degrees and shape unformed natural into ordered vessels. As stones are dressed and unworked wood is taken up by a craftsman, so the Lord shapes ordered vessels — making the dwelling ready for the King.
